results.summary_before: This design is a 9-channel oscillator frequency counter with programmable gate time, controlled over I2C and supplemented by SPI DAC outputs and SPI ADC sampling. It measures the frequency of up to nine external oscillators and provides analog output via a DAC and digital input via an ADC. The design is intended for instrumentation and industrial monitoring applications. It is notable for its multi-channel measurement capability and flexible control interface.
results.summary: This design is a Physically Unclonable Function based on ring oscillator frequency comparisons. It contains 16 ring oscillators and performs 120 pairwise comparisons to generate a 49-bit Lehmer code. The result is read out over a simple SPI slave interface, with busy and done status pins. The design exploits manufacturing variations to create a chip-unique fingerprint.
